question: Which Linux companion app path should OpenClaw core sponsor for this umbrella now that Windows Hub is shipped?
rationale: Current main already covers Windows Hub, but Linux still has no native companion and two active GTK-based PRs make the remaining work a product, ownership, packaging, and security-boundary decision rather than a safe autonomous fix.

options.title: Pick and harden one Linux app track
options.body: Choose the C/GTK or Rust/GTK direction, require real desktop proof plus security/packaging review, and keep this issue open until that path lands or is explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split the umbrella
options.body: Close out the shipped Windows portion in a narrower follow-up and track Linux companion app acceptance, notifications, packaging, and node capabilities as separate maintainer-owned issues.

options.title: Defer Linux companion apps
options.body: Leave Linux on the supported Gateway/CLI path for now and close or relabel the active app PRs only after a maintainer explicitly decides not to sponsor a native app this cycle.

recommendation.title: Pick and harden one Linux app track
recommendation.body: Choose the C/GTK or Rust/GTK direction, require real desktop proof plus security/packaging review, and keep this issue open until that path lands or is explicitly rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, stated the native GTK direction in comments, and is the clearest product-direction owner in the available issue and release-gate history.
